explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/785: for infinite sets A, B of positive integers with A+B containing all large integers and A(x)B(x) ~ x (exact additive complements), Sárközy and Szemerédi [SaSz94] 'proved that it is impossible for A(x)B(x) − x = o(A(x))'. The Lean variant: for infinite A, B ⊆ ℕ with 0 ∉ A, B and IsExactAdditiveComplement A B, ¬ (x ↦ A(x)B(x) − x) =o[atTop] (x ↦ A(x)), with A(x) = |A ∩ [1,x]| and x ranging over ℕ. This is a direct transcription. Faithful.
